geometry.railCutFaces: Open longitudinal side strips retain exact rectangular boundary cross-sections. No decorative cap, overhang or end-profile rounding.

render.alphaMethod: Native opaque surface coverage from deterministic common single sample; no raster correction. Source-scale2 binary coverage is downsampled only in review previews.
render.cameraSurfaceMethod: Native procedural camera-ray radiance, BSDF retained for noncamera transport. No view-specific materials, recoloring or fitting.

nativeAssemblyContract.compositingOrder: Unmodified RGBA source frames, alpha_composite in listed order: back-to-front screenY; equal-depth horizontal tiles left-to-right.
